title: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 | Title Update v1.0.4
summary: Find out the latest EA SPORTS FC™ 27 Update details in the Title Update v.1.0.4 Notes.

sections.title: Overview
sections.summary: EA SPORTS FC™ 27 version 1.0.4 is now live and includes the updates below. There are no gameplay balance and tuning changes in this update.

sections.title: Ultimate Team
sections.summary: Addressed the following issues: In certain situations a Service Unavailable error could appear after completing a match in FUT modes. Sometimes, players could have seen incorrect visuals of base items when opening certain Player Picks.

sections.title: The Grounds
sections.summary: Addressed the following issues: When viewing the active club from the Player Profile, a loading screen requiring a title restart could have occurred in certain situations. Addressed instances of incorrect post-match UI flow.

sections.title: Career Mode
sections.summary: Made the following changes: Reduced the amount of High OVR or High Potential players that could be generated in Manager Career. In Manager Career negotiations, offering a transfer sum significantly higher than a club's requested price will still trigger a…

sections.title: General, Audio, and Visual
sections.summary: Addressed the following issues: In FC Lite, unintended teams could show when randomising teams in Kick-Off. Addressed various stability issues that could have occurred.
